title: Michelle Liu — digital sketchbook
note: Sketches presented as an open sketchbook — full spreads on a minimal background, each labelled city + date, chronological like a travel diary, tied together by a red bookmark ribbon. Her call: add her sketches to lydiashan.com in this format, spreads labelled NYC / Toronto + date, with her pigeon stamp standing in for the ribbon. It also gives her two-month drawing practice a home and later feeds the sticker sheet.
